rationale: Lets inline encoded images in any format a canvas decoder accepts (JPEG, WebP, GIF and PNG, base64 or percent-encoded per RFC 2397) and Knob/Fader sprite strips held as encoded bytes draw through the content-keyed inline image cache, with intrinsic sizes read from the image header by Canvas::measure_image_from_data and no pixel decode. Undecodable payloads are tried once and paint a placeholder; decodable sprite frames are bounded by the declared strip size and raw RGBA strips by their byte count. Pixel output for PNG sources is unchanged; backends without a cache or decoder draw as before. Pulp continues to own this editable canvas target under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits these generic rendering-asset behaviours when that target adopts the Vellum package. No source-routing or authority boundary moves.
